name: cloudbase-agent-python
description: Build production-ready AI agent backends using the CloudBase Agent Python SDK — create agents with LangGraph/CrewAI/LlamaIndex, serve them via FastAPI with AG-UI protocol streaming + OpenAI-compatible endpoints, add tools (bash, filesystem, MCP, code execution), memory (in-memory, TDAI, MySQL, MongoDB), observability (OpenTelemetry/Langfuse), and middleware (auth, logging). Use this skill when the user wants to create an AI agent server, build a chatbot backend, set up human-in-the-loop workflow
author: TencentCloudBase
summary_zh: 用于构建生产级 AI 智能体后端的 Python SDK，适合开发聊天机器人、智能体服务及人工介入工作流。
